remarks: PANORAMIC VIEW HOME ATOP CULVER CREST IN CULVER CITY! Sunsets and City Lights from this home's living room and master bedroom await its next family! This home total renovation is taking place now and will be able to be viewed when complete. New indoor and outdoor paint, new engineered wood floors throughout, recessed lighting, new fixtures, Taj Majal kitchen countertops, new tiled bathroom tub surrounds, tiled bathroom floors and so much more!  Paid off solar with charging station. Wonderful cul-de-sac location and huge lot with wood deck up on the hill. Pictures will be updated as we move along in the renovation.
